releases.title: Clearer review and student learning tools
releases.summary: Three clear teacher review sections, editable evidence selections, XML layout previews, practice points, and lesson-linked slide starters.

changes.text: Read public patch history and receive a notification for each published release in your account inbox.

Review evidence, use an optional Adminerva Auto Checker draft, and enter the final teacher score in three sections. Suggestions copy only when accepted. Protected grades can be unpublished for revision in the same workspace.
Previously selected older commits remain available for editing. Editable selections can be cleared before resubmission, and instructions and rubrics expand when needed.
Edit Android layout XML and preview supported widgets, dimensions, colors and parent-edge constraints in a sandboxed browser view. The simulator is a learning approximation, not Android Studio.
See personal practice points. Instructors can review missions and publish opt-in, alias-only class standings; practice points do not change assessment grades.

Open a saved lesson in the Slide Editor and build editable starter slides without an external service. Saved decks retain their source lesson version; newer lesson versions do not silently replace slide edits.

releases.title: Review & Grade workspace
releases.summary: A simpler teacher review workspace, individual contribution checks, and protected student evidence revisions.

changes.text: Review selected evidence, checkpoint approval, evaluation drafts and group details from Review & Grade.
Evaluation drafts distinguish verified individual contributions from shared project completeness. Teacher review is required; grades are never published automatically.
Students can revise or withdraw evidence before approval. Approved evidence requires instructor reopening, with previous submissions retained.
Account controls fit narrow mobile screens more reliably.
